**verdict**: First-ever training use of the mid-episode shove (dr.ext_push_*) is mechanism-safe AND the walker visibly LEARNS to survive most pushes within 2M. Reward finite and rising all four quarters (2.3/75.6/247.0/334.9, no NaN/crash; stronger shape than faultsmoke1-noamp's 9->209 comparator), and training tilt terminations FELL steadily under a CONSTANT push dose (tilt_pitch 42->15, tilt_roll 27->7-11 per window) -- the recovery-learning signature, not tolerance-by-luck. DR-0 gate at own cfg (push fires every episode): gait_valid 6/6 det + 6/6 sto, zero sacrificed legs, det prog med 1.24 / slip med 3.05 / fwd med 0.70m. Blunt pathology count: the shove still WINS in 1/6 det (walk_det_3 strip: clean upright six-leg walking with real travel for ~13s, then the push flips it -- tilt_roll term) and 3/6 sto episodes (tilt_pitch; sto ep4 badly degraded, prog 0.21 / slip 18.3). This is survive-most-pushes, NOT M3 push recovery -- no regain-gait-after-knockdown was demonstrated, only riding out the pulse. hardware-ready: no. Gate bar (gait_valid>=3/6 det, some recovery signature, not instant-collapse-every-time) comfortably met; the FAIL branch (dose miscalibrated, topple every episode) is refuted.
